name: Hana
background: Arrived this morning with a printed itinerary. The itinerary did not survive the first hour.
speakingStyle: Apologetic, polite, answers questions with her own questions because she is also lost.

fallbacks: I'm so sorry, I'm not from here either.

knowledge.fact: The station? I'm looking for it too! My map says it's here, but I think my map is upside down.
My guidebook recommends a place called 'Golden Spoon' but it's a phone shop now.
I'm from very far away. It is quieter there. Much quieter.

opinions.text: It's beautiful! And very big. And very loud. Is it always this loud?
I'm on holiday! I planned it for a whole year. Day one is going... interestingly.
The forecast said sunny. I only packed sunglasses. Sorry, that's not your fault.

goals: Send one postcard from every city on the trip.
